content: Pixel Agents (MIT) turns Claude Code terminals into animated pixel-art characters via a typed HookProvider interface: SessionStart/PreToolUse/PermissionRequest/Stop hooks (with JSONL transcript scanning as fallback) normalize into an AgentEvent model driving character state (walk/sit/type/read/blocked-with-speech-bubble). React19+Vite+Canvas2D rendering, VS Code extension and standalone CLI share one codebase. Ships an in-app layout editor (floors/walls/furniture, JSON import/export), an areas system (paint named zones mapped to workspace folders), and external asset-pack loading. Competing forks (agent-office, ai-office-simulator, DeskRPG-adjacent) add manager/subagent hierarchies, hiring interns, and persistent cross-session memory.
